title: The Hollow of the Ninefold Court
author: Theo Quintana
blurb: Wren Sterling, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
